## Upgrading from 3.3.5

In 3.3.5, calling `AddHttpClientHints()` enabled `Platform`, `Architecture` and `Device` by default. In 4.0 the default response requests only `Sec-CH-UA` and `Sec-CH-UA-Mobile`. Applications that use the platform version, architecture or model must opt in to those hints.

```csharp
// 3.3.5
builder.Services.AddHttpClientHints();
```

```csharp
// 4.0
builder.Services.AddHttpClientHints(options =>
{
    options.Platform = true;
    options.Architecture = true;
    options.Device = true;
});
```

In 4.0, `Architecture` also requests `Sec-CH-UA-WoW64` and `Device` also requests `Sec-CH-UA-Form-Factors`. To request individual hints, list their field names in `options.Additional`.

If your application used `Configure<HttpClientHintsMiddlewareConfig>(...)`, move that configuration into the `AddHttpClientHints` callback. Replace direct registration through `app.UseMiddleware<HttpClientHintsRequestMiddleware>()` with `app.UseHttpClientHints()`. Both implementation types are now internal.
